decks.notes: The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to maintain control over the game by utilizing efficient spells to disrupt the opponent while maintaining a fast and aggressive tempo. By combining disruption with threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck can apply pressure and adapt to various situations. The deck aims to control the board through countering opponent's spells and removing threats while establishing a strong board presence to quickly finish off the opponent. The synergy between cheap interaction and powerful threats allows for versatility and adaptability in different matchups.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan with powerful creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder. By using mana acceleration and disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to establish a dominant board position early on and maintain control throughout the game. With a mix of powerful creatures, removal spells, and card advantage engines, this deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately outlasting them and securing victory through sheer aggression and efficiency.

The main concept of the deck is to play aggressively with low-cost spells and creatures, while disrupting the opponent with counterspells and land destruction. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also utilizing cards like Daze and Force of Will to protect its own board state. By efficiently managing resources and applying pressure early on, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, from the graveyard. By utilizing cards like Reanimate, Exhume, and Animate Dead, along with cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting to get creatures into the graveyard, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace opponents with devastating creatures. With a mix of disruption through cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize, along with fast mana acceleration from cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, this deck is designed to execute its combo strategy effectively and efficiently.

This deck aims to quickly deploy aggressive creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan by limiting their options. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, as well as creature acceleration like Simian Spirit Guide, this deck can put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Cards like Archon of Emeria and Elite Spellbinder further disrupt the opponent's plays, allowing the pilot to maintain control of the battlefield. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Palace Jailer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional removal and card advantage, ensuring a strategy focused on tempo and efficiency.

This deck focuses on using fast mana sources like City of Traitors and Chrome Mox to accelerate into powerful disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon. By locking down the opponent's mana base and disrupting their game plan, the deck can quickly overwhelm them with aggressive creatures like Legion Warboss, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Fury. The inclusion of Dragon Stompy cards like Dead / Gone and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance adds additional flexibility and power to the deck, allowing it to quickly close out games before the opponent can recover.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through efficient removal spells, counterspells, and card draw while utilizing the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad to generate value from flickering permanents. The deck also includes a toolbox of creatures to search for with Green Sun's Zenith and powerful lands like Field of the Dead to create an advantage as the game progresses. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents by managing resources effectively and constantly putting pressure on the board with a mix of threats and answers.

The main focus of this deck is to establish board presence quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to control the tempo of the game by utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chalice of the Void to hinder the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck incorporates some control elements such as Palace Jailer and Solitude to deal with threats effectively. Overall, this deck is designed to apply pressure early on and maintain control of the game through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of disruptive creatures and removal spells to slow down the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure with efficient threats. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to disrupt the opponent's spells, along with a solid mana denial plan with Wasteland and Rishadan Port, the deck aims to restrict the opponent's options while using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition to present a fast clock and close out the game.

The deck revolves around assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill your opponent's entire deck in one turn. The deck includes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga to help find the combo pieces quickly. Support cards like Force of Will and Mox Opal help protect the combo and generate mana to execute the combo efficiently. The key strategy is to pressure the opponent quickly and disrupt their game plan while setting up the combo for a game-winning mill.

This deck focuses on utilizing equipment like Colossus Hammer and Cranial Plating to quickly create powerful threats on the board. By utilizing Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid, the deck can equip these powerful artifacts for little to no cost, overwhelming opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck also includes disruption elements like Swords to Plowshares and Esper Sentinel to control the game and protect its key combo pieces. With mana acceleration from Mox Opal and utility lands like Urza's Saga, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and dominate the game.

The deck focuses on quickly discarding big creatures such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard, then utilizing cards like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield. This allows the player to cheat powerful creatures into play at a low cost, overwhelming the opponent with big threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruption cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the combo. It aims to win the game through a quick and explosive playstyle based on graveyard interaction and high-impact creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to rapidly mill out opponents. It also utilizes Goblin Welder and various artifacts to control the board and generate value. The deck includes various cards to protect the combo and disrupt opponents, such as Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt. Additionally, there are cards for graveyard recursion, like Reanimate, and alternate win conditions, such as Batterskull and Baleful Strix. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with its synergy and versatility.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying disruptive creatures to control the board and limit the opponent's options. By using mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, the deck can quickly play high-impact creatures like Archon of Emeria and Elite Spellbinder. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Palace Jailer provide removal options to deal with threats. The deck also utilizes Cavern of Souls to protect its creatures from counterspells and efficient lands like Ancient Tomb to generate additional mana. Overall, the deck aims to establish an early advantage and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck revolves around the combo between Painter's Servant and Grindstone, which enables the player to mill out the opponent's library in one turn. The deck also includes various tools like Goblin Welder, Urza's Saga, and Goblin Engineer to set up and protect the combo. Other cards like Lightning Bolt, Pyroblast, and Red Elemental Blast provide interaction and disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

Utilizing powerful graveyard recursion cards and fast mana acceleration, this deck aims to quickly and efficiently reanimate high-impact creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty to overwhelm the opponent. By filling the graveyard with key targets using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, the deck can consistently bring back threats early in the game. With a mix of disruption and card draw, the deck aims to execute its combo game plan with precision and speed to outpace the opponent's strategy.
